access: A non-production target the agent may write to, with a frozen copy of the input, to run the same window twice and compare

presentation.name: Make a pipeline write safe to re-run, and prove it
presentation.summary: Designs loads and transformations so that a retry, repair or backfill of the same window leaves the same result, and proves it by running the window twice.
benefits: Replaces blind appends with an overwrite of the run's window or a merge on a deterministic key
Keeps delete+insert atomic on each engine, so a failed run never leaves a window empty
Finds generated keys, clock-based windows and untied ROW_NUMBER() that make two runs differ
Proves the write with three run-twice tests and an overflow-free checksum per engine
